label: A triangle of money from New York to Toronto to France blocking the Act
description: A dark principality-looking figure toward Pennsylvania and New York holding up the Save America Act through funding, with billions influencing politicians, Carney and bankers in Canada and France behind it, and a triangle running from New York to Toronto into England and France and back, described as an Illuminati wall, with the bull that feeds on the blood of the unborn as the root cause, and a stronghold dated to the 1500s. Disclosed lobbying on the measure is far below the billions he names.

description: After Iran gets its hand out of Babylon, Babylon rises out of nowhere with Saudi Arabia becoming a major leader under MBS who brings a two-state solution with Jared, alongside Saudi restoring the East-West pipeline bypassing the strait at seven million barrels a day and becoming friends with a rising Iraq.
